item_reviews.comment: Gains are 0.7, 1.5, 0.3, 1.6, 1.6 and 0.3, so the stated range of 0.3–1.6 is correct.
The averages of 79.4 and 78.4 are in T2, so the 1.0-point gap is correct.
The average is 79.4 vs 80.0. Larchmont-GNN is higher on Hollin-Sol and Jessamine-Kin and lower on the other four.
The T3 values are correct. Each removal lowers the average, though no significance tests are reported.
The package states that no statistical tests were reported. The caveat matters because the gains are small.

missing_core_findings.description: Larchmont-GNN costs slightly more than Quintrell-MP (4.8M vs 4.1M parameters; 210 vs 180 ms per 1,000 molecules). Neither needs pretraining. Avonlea-Chem-XL is far larger and costlier (310M parameters, 2950 ms, 2400 GPU-hours), and Larchmont-GNN's average is within 0.6 points of it.
